newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain's Sitra refinery unit to temporarily close.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's Sitra refinery unit to temporarily close.

text.p: The Bahrain Petroleum Company (BAPCO) plans to shut crude oil distillation unit 4 at its Sitra refinery for maintenance in July, Bahrain's al-Ayam newspaper said on Sunday.
Maintenance of the 104,000 barrels per day (bpd) capacity unit will take about a month, the paper reported.
BAPCO, which runs the 250,000 bpd refinery, is 60 percent owned by the Bahraini government and 40 percent by Caltex, owned by Chevron Corp and Texaco.
It is a major Gulf exporter of middle distillates such as diesel to the Middle East, Africa, Indian sub-continent and Asian markets.
